say: zigdag's own structures are not designed: 79 types cross component boundaries as bare str, int or unrecorded classes
78 interface names that other components use have no one-line description
zigdag's data is designed: 126 classes are recorded structures, and the plain types that cross are named (texts, measures, names); edge-types is on, with bool fields allowed as bool returns are
zigdag fmt moves a comment when a value holds the Unicode line separator U+2028: the property test test_formatting_any_file_is_stable_and_lossless found it by chance, and now fails on it every run
comments are placed by the lines YAML counts, which end only at a line feed or a carriage return

evidence: read_log of one event whose text is 'one\u2028two' reports: not JSON: Unterminated string
say: the log cannot be read back when an event's text holds U+2028: events are written with the character as it is, and read with splitlines, which ends a line there
